## Wave 2 Summary

This wave assembles the single most important *unbuilt* phononic gate in the framework and reads its observables. **TRANSIT-PS-67** — the full mode-by-mode post-fold GGE acoustic power spectrum `P(k) = Σ_k |β_k|² |mode-fn|²` — has never been computed end-to-end; every downstream cosmological observable (n_s(k), α_s, A_s, the bispectrum normalization) currently rests on piecewise sub-computations stitched by hand, not on one transfer function (qa survey G-QA-1, the highest-EVOI item in the phononic sector). The wave is four compute gates: **W2-1** assembles the spectrum SHAPE (mode-by-mode sudden-quench Bogoliubov P(k) → n_s(k)) at the highest tractable L_max; **W2-2** extracts the Sakharov acoustic-peak phase from the substrate sound horizon and confronts the recorded BAO θ_A 0.78%/2.6σ residual (the framework's first acoustic-peak-position prediction); **W2-3** completes the half-finished bispectrum-shape falsifier (the PRE-REG-INC `S88-F-NL-EQUILATERAL` arm → the (f_NL^local, f_NL^equil, f_NL^folded) triple) and ADDS the trispectrum τ_NL from the two-mode-squeezed (k,−k) structure, testing Suyama-Yamaguchi saturation; **W2-4** re-opens the FLOQUET characterization of the LIVE S101 in-band parametric resonance (ω_q=2.0128 M_KK, γ=29.7532, §VII.BP COINCIDENCE-BOUNDED) as a preheating phenomenon, computing the Floquet exponent μ_F across the period-2 tongue.

**Substrate framing (load-bearing — `phononic-framing.md`)**: the CMB IS the acoustic signature of the post-transit GGE relic, not thermal equilibrium radiation. The density perturbations the CMB records ARE the interference pattern of the post-transit GGE acoustic excitations; structure formation is that GGE interference pattern self-organized through the a₂ gravitational channel. The direction of explanation flows `D_K eigenvalues → spectral-action moments → ω_k(η) mode structure → frozen P(k) → observed CMB`. The substrate is the power spectrum; the lab measures its image IN a continuum container. This wave builds the object — the mode-by-mode Bogoliubov spectrum — that would actually *produce* that interference pattern.

**Scope boundary (W2-1 builds SHAPE, NOT amplitude)**: the A_s amplitude NORMALIZATION mechanism (the 3.15-under vs 9.5-over 12-OOM sign-flip; qa G-QA-2/C-QA-2/B-QA-1) is the **INV10-W4-1 workshop** question (qa ↔ tesla adjudication; neutral-planned by `gen-physicist`; quantum-acoustics is a participant). W2-1 produces the spectrum shape n_s(k) and the dimensionless P(k) profile; it does NOT adjudicate which normalization (finite-pair static structure factor vs resonance-impedance step) sets the absolute amplitude. The two are scoped apart deliberately: W2-1 tells W4-1 the shape; W4-1 tells a future TRANSIT-PS-promotion gate the normalization.

# (7) substitution_chain
substitution_chain:
  required: true
  content: |
    Claim: "The assembled fold-frozen power spectrum has a RED tilt, n_s(k_pivot) < 1."

    Definition 1: P_ζ(k) := (k³/2π²)|u_k/z|²_{late}  [s67_transit_ps.py; the frozen
                  curvature perturbation at late conformal time, z = a√(2ε) the
                  Mukhanov variable].
    Definition 2: n_s(k) := 1 + d ln P_ζ(k) / d ln k   [standard tilt definition].
    Definition 3: For superhorizon modes at the fold (z''/z >> c_s²k², s67: z''/z
                  ~9.2e5 vs c_s²k_transit² ~3.4e5 for k<1974 M_KK), u_k freezes to
                  u_k/z -> const + (decaying mode), so |u_k/z|²_{late} is set by the
                  super-horizon-crossing amplitude, which scales as the mode's
                  spectral weight at horizon exit.
    Definition 4: The substrate spectral-moment tilt is n_s - 1 = (d_s - 4)/2 with
                  d_s ≈ 3.91 (the M⁴-summand effective spectral dimension needed for
                  the red tilt); the substrate canonical n_s = 0.9595 (BCS+CW,
                  MEMORY.md), so n_s - 1 = -0.0405 < 0.

    Substitute (the tilt of the frozen spectrum):
      n_s(k_pivot) - 1 = d ln P_ζ / d ln k |_{k_pivot}
                       = d ln[(k³/2π²)|u_k/z|²] / d ln k
                       = 3 + d ln|u_k/z|² / d ln k

    Simplify (the frozen super-horizon amplitude carries the spectral-moment
    scaling; for a near-scale-invariant fold-frozen spectrum d ln|u_k/z|²/d ln k
    = -3 + (n_s - 1)_{spectral-moment}, i.e. the 3 from the k³ prefactor is
    cancelled by the -3 of the frozen amplitude up to the small spectral-moment
    deviation):
      n_s(k_pivot) - 1 = 3 + (-3 + (n_s-1)_{spectral-moment})
                       = (n_s - 1)_{spectral-moment}
                       = (d_s - 4)/2
                       = (3.91 - 4)/2
                       = -0.045

    Canonical form: n_s(k_pivot) - 1 = (d_s - 4)/2 < 0  for d_s < 4.

    Direction: d_s ≈ 3.91 < 4  ⇒  (d_s - 4)/2 < 0  ⇒  n_s(k_pivot) < 1 (RED tilt).
    Conclusion: The assembled fold-frozen spectrum is red-tilted; the gate PASSES
                if the computed n_s(k_pivot) lands in [0.94, 0.98]. (The sign is
                forced by d_s < 4; the magnitude is the computed output, and is
                CROSS-CHECKED against the INV10-W1-1 cascade exponent n_s-1 =
                cascade exponent when that gate has landed.)

## Wave 2 → Wave 4 Decision Point

Wave 2 feeds the **INV10-W4-1** workshop (A_s normalization mechanism, qa ↔ tesla; neutral-planned in W4) but does NOT block it — W4-1 adjudicates the A_s *mechanism* by physics argument (the A_s spread + the two candidate normalizations, both already on disk), independent of the TRANSIT-PS compute. W2-1 informs W4-1 (it produces the spectrum shape the A_s normalization is applied to) but the workshop's verdict tells a *future* TRANSIT-PS-promotion gate which normalization to use, not vice versa.

| W2 outcome | Downstream action |
|:-----------|:------------------|
| **W2-1 PASS** (spectrum built, n_s in band) | The master transfer function exists; the shape is fixed. INV10-W4-1 adjudicates the A_s amplitude on this shape. A session-promotion carry-forward lifts TRANSIT-PS-67 into a `session-{N}` gate (the investigation result becomes permanent only via session migration per `gate-verdicts.md §"Investigation-Track Canonical Path"`). W2-2 (Sakharov) consumes the P(k). |
| **W2-1 FAIL** (n_s out of band) | The end-to-end assembly exposes a shape inconsistency the piecewise pieces hid. INV10-W4-1 still runs (the A_s mechanism question is independent of the shape verdict) but the n_s(k) inconsistency becomes a high-priority session carry-forward (localize where the piecewise n_s and the assembled n_s diverge). W2-2 honestly closes (no consistent P(k) to modulate). |
| **W2-1 INFO** (regime-dominated tilt) | The master assembly exists with a regime caveat (e.g. frozen-superhorizon extraction dominates). W2-2 consumes the P(k) with the caveat carried. The functional-choice (√x cutoff) dependence is flagged for a multi-cutoff session sweep. |
| **W2-3 PASS** (SY saturation) | The trispectrum falsifier τ_NL=1.53 is registered (session-promotion + mack falsifier-inventory row, HY5); the relic's single-source squeezed-vacuum character is confirmed at the trispectrum level. |
| **W2-4 PASS** (μ_F > 0 LIVE) | The §VII.BP COINCIDENCE-BOUNDED entry is characterized as a real Floquet/preheating phenomenon + a DTC candidate; the modulus effective-action handle feeds the A-QA-2 / S3-assumption question (a session carry-forward on replacing the spectral-action functional). |
| **W2-4 FAIL** (μ_F = 0) | Parametric amplification closed even for the post-S101 drive; the COINCIDENCE-BOUNDED entry is confirmed a literal kinematic coincidence (no dynamical channel) — reinforces the S57/S67 closure. |
